release_notes:

2. Setting Tooltips Across All Inputs: Added native hover tooltips to all Back Office settings (GTM Container ID, Event Prefix, Server-Side GTM, Consent Mode v2).
3. In-Place Upgrade: Seamless 1-click update via upgrade-1.10.2.php.
